```yaml
  /api/imcs/v1/leave:
    post:
      tags: [客服]
      operationId: csLeave
      summary: 留联系方式，把排队转成留言
      description: |
        没有坐席在、排队中时可用：把这次排队立刻结束并转成留言（工单），内容就是用户这次说的话。已经转成留言的，只更新那张单的联系方式。
        手机号与邮箱至少填一项。有坐席在、用户还没说过话、联系方式不合法、留言已处理完回 400 `VALIDATION`；站点没启用工单或没开启留言回 404 `VALIDATION`；同一用户每小时最多 5 次，超出回 `IM_RATE_LIMITED`（HTTP 200）。
      security: [{ UserToken: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                contact_name: { type: string, maxLength: 50, description: 称呼，选填 }
                contact_phone: { type: string, maxLength: 30, pattern: '^([0-9+\- ]{5,30})?$', description: 联系电话 }
                contact_email: { type: string, maxLength: 120, description: 邮箱 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 成功返回单号；业务失败见说明。
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OkEnvelope'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        required: [ticket_no]
                        properties:
                          ticket_no: { type: string, example: T20261124123456 }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/TokenInvalid' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/LicenseError' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Internal' }

  /api/imcs/v1/sessions/{id}/rating:
    parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        description: 接待 id，取评价邀请消息的 `content.data.session_id`
        schema: { type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1 }
    post:
      tags: [客服]
      operationId: csRateSession
      summary: 评价一次接待
      description: |
        每次接待只能评一次，只能评自己的、已结束的接待。重复评价、评别人的或未结束的回 400 `VALIDATION`（`message` 为「无法评价」），
        评分越界、评语超长同样回 400 `VALIDATION`。站点客服不可用时也回 400 `VALIDATION`。
      security: [{ UserToken: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [rating]
              properties:
                rating: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 5, description: 评分 1–5 }
                comment: { type: string, maxLength: 200, description: 评语，可选，≤200 字 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: 成功返回被评价的接待 id。
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OkEnvelope'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: object
                        required: [id]
                        properties:
                          id: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 接待 id }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/TokenInvalid' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/LicenseError' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Internal' }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKey:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Api-Key
      description: 接入应用的 API Key（形如 `imk_…`），只放在接入方后端，不要下发到客户端。
    UserToken:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      description: '接入方后端调「签用户令牌」拿到的用户令牌，放在 `Authorization: Bearer <令牌>`。'

  parameters:
    UserIdPath:
      name: user_id
      in: path
      required: true
      description: 用户 id，限 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}`
      schema: { type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$' }
    TargetPath:
      name: target
      in: path
      required: true
      description: 被拉黑方 user_id，限 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}`（所以 `@cs` 不合法）
      schema: { type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$' }
    PeerIdPath:
      name: peer_id
      in: path
      required: true
      description: 会话对方的 user_id；该用户的客服会话写 `@cs`
      schema: { type: string, pattern: '^(@cs|[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64})$' }
    MessageIdPath:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      description: 消息 id
      schema: { type: integer, format: int64 }
    ConversationIdPath:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      description: 会话 id（conversation_id）
      schema: { type: integer, format: int64 }
    AfterSeq:
      name: after_seq
      in: query
      required: false
      description: 补拉：返回 seq > after_seq 的消息；与 before_seq 只能传一个
      schema: { type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 0 }
    BeforeSeq:
      name: before_seq
      in: query
      required: false
      description: 翻历史：返回 seq < before_seq 的消息；与 after_seq 只能传一个
      schema: { type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 0 }
    MessageLimit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      required: false
      description: 默认 30，最大 100（超出按 100）
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 30 }
    BlockOffset:
      name: offset
      in: query
      required: false
      description: 跳过的条数，默认 0；`has_more` 为 true 时加上本页条数取下一页
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 0, default: 0 }
    BlockLimit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      required: false
      description: 默认 50，最大 200（超出按 200）
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 200, default: 50 }

  responses:
    OkConversationSettings:
      description: 成功返回该会话在本人这一侧的设置。
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            allOf:
              - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OkEnvelope'
              - type: object
                properties:
                  data: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConversationSettings' }
    OkConversationSettingsOrRateLimited:
      description: 成功返回会话设置；或 `IM_RATE_LIMITED`（HTTP 200，code 非 0）。
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            oneOf:
              - allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OkEnvelope'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConversationSettings' }
              - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    OkEmpty:
      description: 成功，`data` 为 `{}`。
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            allOf:
              - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OkEnvelope'
              - type: object
                properties:
                  data: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmptyObject' }
    OkEmptyOrRateLimited:
      description: 成功时 `data` 为 `{}`；接入应用调用超频时为 `IM_RATE_LIMITED`。
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            oneOf:
              - allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OkEnvelope'
                  - type: object
                    properties:
                      data: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmptyObject' }
              - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    BadRequest:
      description: '`VALIDATION`：参数不合法，`message` 说明原因。'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    KeyInvalid:
      description: '`IM_KEY_INVALID`：`X-Api-Key` 缺失、错误，或接入应用已停用。'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    TokenInvalid:
      description: '`IM_TOKEN_INVALID`：用户令牌缺失、验签失败、已过期，或用户已被封禁 / 踢下线，向接入方后端换新令牌后重试。'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    LicenseError:
      description: '`LICENSE_INVALID` / `LICENSE_EXPIRED` / `LICENSE_DOMAIN`：IM 站点授权异常，联系 IM 服务提供方。'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    ForbiddenOrLicense:
      description: '`FORBIDDEN`：不是该会话成员（或会话不存在）；或 `LICENSE_*`：站点授权异常。'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    NotFound:
      description: '`VALIDATION`：会话不存在（HTTP 404）。'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
    Internal:
      description: '`INTERNAL`：服务端错误（含令牌校验时数据库暂时不可用），可稍后重试；不要当成令牌失效处理。'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }

  schemas:
    DateTime:
      type: string
      pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$'
      description: Asia/Shanghai 时间，`YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`
      examples: ['2026-11-20 10:00:00']

    EmptyObject:
      type: object
      maxProperties: 0
      description: 空对象 `{}`

    OkEnvelope:
      type: object
      description: 成功响应包。`code` 恒为整数 0，`data` 的形状见各接口。
      required: [code, message, data]
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
          const: 0
        message:
          type: string
          const: ok
        data:
          type: object

    ErrorCode:
      type: string
      description: |
        失败响应的业务码（字符串）。HTTP 状态与业务码的对应：
        - `VALIDATION`：400 参数不合法；404 会话不存在（服务端审计查询）、消息不存在（撤回）
        - `IM_KEY_INVALID`：401
        - `IM_TOKEN_INVALID`：401
        - `IM_USER_NOT_FOUND`、`IM_USER_DISABLED`、`IM_MESSAGE_REJECTED`、`IM_RATE_LIMITED`、`IM_BLOCKED`、`IM_RECALL_NOT_ALLOWED`：200
        - `FORBIDDEN`：403 不是会话成员
        - `LICENSE_INVALID`、`LICENSE_EXPIRED`、`LICENSE_DOMAIN`：403 站点授权异常
        - `INTERNAL`：500
      enum:
        - VALIDATION
        - IM_KEY_INVALID
        - IM_TOKEN_INVALID
        - IM_USER_NOT_FOUND
        - IM_USER_DISABLED
        - IM_MESSAGE_REJECTED
        - IM_RATE_LIMITED
        - IM_BLOCKED
        - IM_RECALL_NOT_ALLOWED
        - FORBIDDEN
        - INTERNAL
        - LICENSE_INVALID
        - LICENSE_EXPIRED
        - LICENSE_DOMAIN

    ErrorEnvelope:
      type: object
      description: 失败响应包。`code` 为字符串错误码，`message` 为中文说明，`data` 恒为 `{}`。
      required: [code, message, data]
      properties:
        code: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorCode' }
        message:
          type: string
          description: 中文说明。`IM_MESSAGE_REJECTED` 形如「消息被拒绝：<原因>」，`IM_BLOCKED` 为「对方已将你拉黑」。
        data: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/EmptyObject' }

    UserInput:
      type: object
      required: [user_id]
      properties:
        user_id: { type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$' }
        nickname: { type: string, maxLength: 64, description: 可空，≤64 字 }
        avatar_url: { type: string, maxLength: 512, description: 可空，http(s) 且 ≤512 字符 }

    UserIdData:
      type: object
      required: [user_id]
      properties:
        user_id: { type: string }

    User:
      type: object
      required: [user_id, nickname, avatar_url]
      properties:
        user_id: { type: string, description: 用户 id；平台客服为 `@cs` }
        nickname: { type: string, description: 昵称，可能为空串 }
        avatar_url: { type: string, description: 头像链接，可能为空串 }

    Me:
      description: 当前用户与站点开关
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        - type: object
          required: [features]
          properties:
            features:
              type: object
              description: 站点在「IM 设置」里的开关；旧版服务端没有这个字段
              properties:
                recall_minutes: { type: integer, minimum: 0, description: 撤回时限（分钟），0 = 没开启 }
                read_receipt: { type: boolean, description: 是否显示对方已读 }

    UploadResult:
      type: object
      required: [attachment_id, url, ticket]
      properties:
        attachment_id: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 附件 id，发图片 / 语音消息时带上 }
        url: { type: string, description: 临时链接，仅供本地预览 }
        ticket: { type: string, description: 上传凭证，与上传者绑定，发图片 / 语音消息时带上 }

    BlockItem:
      type: object
      required: [user_id, created_at]
      properties:
        user_id: { type: string, description: 被拉黑方 user_id（不带昵称头像，请用自己的用户资料展示） }
        created_at: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/DateTime' }

    BlockPage:
      type: object
      required: [items, has_more]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/BlockItem' }
        has_more: { type: boolean, description: 是否还有下一页 }

    # ---- 消息内容 ----
    TextContent:
      type: object
      title: text
      required: [text]
      properties:
        text: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 5000, description: 1–5000 字，不能全是空白 }

    ImageUploadContent:
      type: object
      title: image（上传图，发送时）
      description: 发送上传图时的形态；`attachment_id` 与 `ticket` 来自上传接口，且必须是发送者本人上传的。
      required: [attachment_id, ticket, width, height]
      properties:
        attachment_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        ticket: { type: string }
        width: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20000 }
        height: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20000 }

    ImageAttachmentContent:
      type: object
      title: image（上传图，读取时）
      description: 读取到的上传图形态；`url` 是每次读取时现签的临时链接（约 24 小时有效），不要长期保存。
      required: [attachment_id, width, height, url]
      properties:
        attachment_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        width: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20000 }
        height: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20000 }
        url: { type: string, description: 现签临时链接；签名失败时为空串 }

    VoiceUploadContent:
      type: object
      title: voice（发送时）
      description: 语音；attachment_id 与 ticket 来自 `/upload`（kind=voice），必须是发送者本人上传的。服务端代发不支持。
      required: [attachment_id, ticket, duration]
      properties:
        attachment_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        ticket: { type: string }
        duration: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 60, description: 秒，客户端上报 }

    VoiceContent:
      type: object
      title: voice（读取时）
      required: [attachment_id, duration, size, mime, url]
      properties:
        attachment_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        duration: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 60, description: 秒 }
        size: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 字节 }
        mime: { type: string, enum: [audio/mp4, audio/mpeg, audio/wave], description: audio/wave 只出现在微信用户发来的语音里（8kHz 单声道） }
        url: { type: string, description: 现签临时链接（约 24 小时有效）；签名失败时为空串 }

    RecalledContent:
      type: object
      title: recalled（已撤回）
      required: [by]
      properties:
        by: { type: string, enum: [sender, agent, server], description: sender 发送者 / agent 坐席 / server 接入方 }

    ImageUrlContent:
      type: object
      title: image（外链图）
      description: 外链图，发送与读取形态相同，原样存取。与 attachment_id 二选一。
      required: [url, width, height]
      not: { required: [attachment_id] }
      properties:
        url: { type: string, maxLength: 1024, description: https 链接，≤1024 字符 }
        width: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20000 }
        height: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20000 }

    LocationContent:
      type: object
      title: location
      required: [lat, lng]
      properties:
        lat: { type: number, minimum: -90, maximum: 90 }
        lng: { type: number, minimum: -180, maximum: 180 }
        name: { type: string, maxLength: 100, description: 地点名，≤100 字 }
        address: { type: string, maxLength: 200, description: 地址，≤200 字 }

    CustomContent:
      type: object
      title: custom
      required: [data, desc]
      properties:
        data:
          type: object
          description: 必须是 JSON 对象，压缩序列化后 ≤8KB（含 im_card）。其余键归接入方自用；im_card 是保留键，见接入文档 §5.9
          additionalProperties: true
          properties:
            im_card: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImCard' }
        desc:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100
          description: 1–100 字，用于会话预览与离线推送文字

    ImCard:
      type: object
      title: im_card
      description: |
        业务卡片通用外壳（接入文档 §5.9）。键存在就必须是对象；不合规范整条消息回 400 `VALIDATION`。
        未列出的键原样保存、渲染方忽略。服务端只校验格式与长度，不判断链接能否打开。
      required: [title]
      additionalProperties: true
      properties:
        title: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 64, description: 去首尾空白后 1–64 字 }
        kind: { type: string, maxLength: 20, description: 推荐 order / product / service / article / page，只用于显示类型名；其他值显示为「链接」；ticket 由站点工单进展使用 }
        subtitle: { type: string, maxLength: 100, description: ≤100 字 }
        image: { type: string, format: uri, maxLength: 1024, description: https 链接 }
        fields:
          type: array
          maxItems: 6
          description: 关键信息，发送时快照
          items:
            type: object
            required: [label, value]
            properties:
              label: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 10 }
              value: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 64 }
        web_link: { type: string, format: uri, maxLength: 1024, description: https；网站 / H5 / 客服工作台打开 }
        app_link: { type: string, maxLength: 1024, description: 原生 App 内跳转，不含空白，scheme 不限 }
        mp_path: { type: string, maxLength: 512, pattern: '^/\S*$', description: 小程序页面路径，以 / 开头、不含空白 }
        mp_appid: { type: string, maxLength: 32, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$', description: 跳另一个小程序时填；只有带了 mp_path 才能填 }

    SendMessageRequest:
      type: object
      description: 发消息请求。content 按 type 取对应形态，多余字段会被丢弃。
      required: [to, type, content, client_msg_id]
      properties:
        to: { type: string, description: 接收方 user_id，不能是自己；客户端可填 `@cs` 发给平台客服 }
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [text, image, voice, location, custom]
        content:
          description: text → TextContent；image → ImageUploadContent 或 ImageUrlContent（二选一）；voice → VoiceUploadContent；location → LocationContent；custom → CustomContent
          oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImageUploadContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImageUrlContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VoiceUploadContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/LocationContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomContent'
        client_msg_id: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 64, description: 客户端生成的唯一 id（建议 UUID），重试时沿用同一个 }

    ServerSendMessageRequest:
      description: 代发请求，比客户端发消息多一个 `from`。代发图片请用外链图形态。
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SendMessageRequest'
        - type: object
          required: [from]
          properties:
            from: { type: string, description: 发送者 user_id，不能是 `@cs` }

    Message:
      type: object
      description: 消息对象。发消息的返回、拉消息列表、推送、回调里都是这个形状。
      required: [id, conversation_id, seq, from, type, content, client_msg_id, created_at]
      properties:
        id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        seq: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 会话内序号，从 1 开始连续递增 }
        from: { type: string, description: 发送者 user_id；客服发来的为 `@cs` }
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [text, image, voice, location, custom, recalled]
          description: recalled 为已撤回；将来可能增加取值，不认识的兜底显示
        content:
          description: text → TextContent；image → ImageAttachmentContent 或 ImageUrlContent；voice → VoiceContent；recalled → RecalledContent；location → LocationContent；custom → CustomContent
          oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TextContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImageAttachmentContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImageUrlContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VoiceContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/RecalledContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/LocationContent'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/CustomContent'
        client_msg_id: { type: string }
        sender_role:
          type: string
          enum: [agent, bot, system]
          description: 只有 `@cs` 的消息带。agent 坐席 / bot 机器人（内容由 AI 生成，界面要标识）/ system 系统提示；将来可能增加取值，不认识的按 system 处理
        created_at: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/DateTime' }

    MessagePage:
      type: object
      required: [items, has_more]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          description: 一律按 seq 升序
          items: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message' }
        has_more:
          type: boolean
          description: 查询方向上是否还有更多：补拉时表示后面还有新消息；翻历史 / 最新一页时表示更早还有

    LastMessage:
      type: object
      required: [seq, from, type, preview, created_at]
      properties:
        seq: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        from: { type: string }
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [text, image, voice, location, custom, recalled]
        preview:
          type: string
          description: 会话预览文字：text 取前 50 字，image 为「[图片]」，voice 为「[语音]」，location 为「[位置]」，custom 取 desc，已撤回为「[消息已撤回]」
        created_at: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/DateTime' }

    Conversation:
      type: object
      description: 会话列表的一项。客服会话 `type` 为 `service`、`peer.user_id` 固定为 `@cs`。
      required: [conversation_id, type, peer, last_message, unread, max_seq, read_seq, last_msg_at, clear_seq, pinned, pinned_at, muted]
      properties:
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [c2c, service]
          description: c2c 普通单聊；service 平台客服会话
        peer: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/User' }
        last_message:
          description: 最后一条消息摘要，请判空：本人清空过记录（最后一条 seq 不超过 clear_seq）时为 null，极少数情况下也可能为 null
          oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/LastMessage'
            - type: 'null'
        unread: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 未读数 = max_seq − read_seq }
        max_seq: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        read_seq: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        last_msg_at: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/DateTime' }
        clear_seq: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 本人清空到的序号，拉消息只会返回比它大的 seq；没清空过为 0 }
        pinned: { type: boolean, description: 本人是否置顶 }
        pinned_at:
          description: 置顶时间，未置顶为 null
          oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/DateTime'
            - type: 'null'
        muted: { type: boolean, description: 本人是否免打扰；免打扰会话的 unread 照常计数，但不计入总未读 }
        peer_read_seq: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 对方读到哪条；站点没开启对方已读、以及客服会话没有这个字段 }

    ConversationSettings:
      type: object
      description: 某用户在某会话里的设置（只属于本人，对方看不到）。
      required: [conversation_id, peer_user_id, pinned, pinned_at, muted, clear_seq, unread, visible]
      properties:
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        peer_user_id: { type: string, description: 对方 user_id，客服会话为 `@cs` }
        pinned: { type: boolean }
        pinned_at:
          description: 置顶时间，未置顶为 null
          oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/DateTime'
            - type: 'null'
        muted: { type: boolean, description: 免打扰 }
        clear_seq: { type: integer, format: int64, description: 清空到的序号，seq 不超过它的消息本人看不到 }
        unread: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        visible: { type: boolean, description: 是否出现在本人会话列表里（删除后为 false，有新消息时恢复） }

    PushConversationChanged:
      type: object
      description: |
        **经长连接下发**，见接入文档 §6。本人置顶 / 免打扰 / 清空 / 删除会话成功后推给本人所有在线设备（不推给对方），
        `conversation` 带完整设置，客户端直接覆盖本地。`clear` / `delete` 时删除本地 `seq <= clear_seq` 的消息，`delete` 时把会话移出列表。
      required: [event, action, conversation]
      properties:
        event: { type: string, const: conversation_changed }
        action:
          type: string
          enum: [settings, clear, delete]
        conversation: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConversationSettings' }

    # ---- 长连接推送事件 ----
    PushMessage:
      type: object
      description: |
        **经长连接下发**（不是 HTTP 响应），见接入文档 §6。新消息事件，同时推给收发双方的所有在线设备；
        发送设备自己也会收到，按 `message.id`（或 `client_msg_id`）与 HTTP 返回去重。`seq` 大于本地最大 seq + 1 时说明漏了，需补拉。
      required: [event, conversation_id, seq, message]
      properties:
        event: { type: string, const: message }
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        seq: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        message: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message' }

    PushRead:
      type: object
      description: '**经长连接下发**，见接入文档 §6。标已读后推给本人所有在线设备，用于多端同步角标。'
      required: [event, conversation_id, read_seq]
      properties:
        event: { type: string, const: read }
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        read_seq: { type: integer, format: int64 }

    PushMessageRecalled:
      type: object
      description: |
        **经长连接下发**，见接入文档 §6。消息被撤回，推给双方所有在线设备（含发起设备）。按 `message.id` 替换本地那条，
        撤回不可逆；本地没有这个会话时忽略。离线漏掉的用 `GET /api/im/v1/recalls` 补齐。
      required: [event, conversation_id, seq, message]
      properties:
        event: { type: string, const: message_recalled }
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        seq: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        message: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message' }

    PushPeerRead:
      type: object
      description: '**经长连接下发**，见接入文档 §6。对方读到新的位置（站点开启对方已读时），只进不退。'
      required: [event, conversation_id, peer_read_seq]
      properties:
        event: { type: string, const: peer_read }
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        peer_read_seq: { type: integer, format: int64 }

    PushTyping:
      type: object
      description: '**经长连接下发**，见接入文档 §6。`from` 正在输入，`expires_in` 秒内没有新的、或收到他的消息就不再显示。'
      required: [event, conversation_id, from, expires_in]
      properties:
        event: { type: string, const: typing }
        conversation_id: { type: integer, format: int64 }
        from: { type: string, description: 客服会话里为 `@cs` }
        expires_in: { type: integer, description: 秒 }

    PushReadAll:
      type: object
      description: |
        **经长连接下发**，见接入文档 §6。一键清全部未读且确有变更时推给本人频道（所有在线设备，含发起设备），不带会话信息：
        收到后把本地各会话未读清零、总未读归零，或重新拉一次会话列表。
      required: [event]
      properties:
        event: { type: string, const: read_all }
```
